visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a black crop top and a long black skirt with a silver shoulder bag, stands in front of a store with a large green sign that reads '3COINS +plus'. She waves her right hand enthusiastically at the camera. The setting is a brightly lit shopping mall with several other shoppers walking in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman standing in front of a glass wall with the store logo. She holds up five fingers of her right hand, gesturing to the camera. (3) The woman is now inside the store, standing in front of a display rack of cosmetics. She picks up and shows various lip tints and perfume atomizers packaged as keychains. She gestures towards them and shows how they can be attached to her bag. (4) She moves to a section with lace scarves and headbands. She touches the fabric of a white lace headband and shows a black one as well, pointing to a price tag. The background is filled with rows of accessories on shelves. (5) The woman stands in front of a large wall of jewelry, including earrings and necklaces. She gestures towards the vast collection and picks up a thin gold necklace to show the camera. Other shoppers are visible in the blurred background. (6) She points towards a rack of grey and black slippers. The camera zooms in on the slippers, which are designed to be worn from either side. (7) Finally, she shows a multi-hanger clothing rack. A brief overlay clip shows the hanger in use, where all clothes fall off with one click. She smiles and gestures with the product packaging.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 跟大家分享. [Logo]: 3COINS. [Slogan]: 3COINS +plus. (2) [Slogan]: 5樣必買好物. [Variety]: 1 吊飾系列化妝品. (3) [Subtitle]: 有這個! 這樣才100塊台幣, 超級便宜的, 然後你再把它這樣子, 吊在你的包包上, 絕對不會忘記帶你的口紅. [Variety]: 吊口紅超可愛! (4) [Subtitle]: 這一定要買, 香水, 便宜, 選來選去覺得這個最值得, 因為這個可以放進自己的香水, 然後把它這樣吊著, 就可以隨時補香水的味道. (5) [Variety]: 2 多用途蕾絲絲巾. [Subtitle]: 這個是我一直在找的一個絲巾, 一百! 哎唷, 怎麼那麼便宜啊, 比我媽的抹布還便宜, 100塊台幣才20元, 我是要綁的, 所以我要買這個, 它的這個材質, 摸起來非常的舒服, 我要買這條. (6) [Variety]: 3 耳環飾品. [Subtitle]: 還有我自己個人最喜歡的飾品, 應有盡有, 300塊錢, 超多人問我說, 我的那個飾品或者是什麼項鍊在哪裡買的, 全部都是在3COINS買的, 我至少買了這條有20條吧, (比誰多嗎 XD) 這我有兩條. (7) [Variety]: 4 雙向拖鞋. [Subtitle]: 我上次看那個BRUCE老婆莎莎有買啊, 因為他就說在陽台的時候, 你就有時候穿拖鞋都很麻煩, 前後都可以穿! 這個超方便的. (8) [Variety]: 5 神奇懶人衣架. [Slogan]: 日本3coins 神奇懶人衣架. [Subtitle]: 最後是這個, 這個不就是蔡阿嘎介紹的嗎? 就是一按全部衣服掉下來, 3COINS買起來!
